Irrigation & Waterways Dept, Govt of Rajasthan
Letter of Recommendation
LETTER OF RECOMMENDATION
Our ref: 90
31/03/2026
This office has engaged M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. for the work “Pumping Station —
Rajasthan Pkg-100” (Rs. 1773.00 Lakh), completed on 13/12/2011. On the basis of that engagement
we record the following:
Adherence to the sanctioned programme of work and milestone dates;
Quality of workmanship accepted at inspection without material objection;
Compliance with safety and statutory obligations on site;
Responsiveness of the contractor's site management.
National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. completed the engagement within the sanctioned time and cost,
and their conduct on site was professional throughout. We would consider them for similar works.
Verification: Divya Iyer, ee@dept.gov.in, +91-9830000000.
